title: Deborah and Barak

questions.question: Who was the prophetess judging Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:4 (ESV): "Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time."

questions.question: Who was the commander of Jabin's army?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:2 (ESV): "...The commander of his army was Sisera..."

questions.question: What did Barak say to Deborah?
options: If you will go with me, I will go
questions.correctAnswer: If you will go with me, I will go
questions.explanation: Judges 4:8 (ESV): "Barak said to her, 'If you will go with me, I will go, but if you will not go with me, I will not go.'"

questions.question: Who killed Sisera?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:21 (ESV): "But Jael the wife of Heber took a tent peg... and drove the peg into his temple..."

questions.question: How did Jael kill Sisera?
options: With a tent peg through the temple
questions.correctAnswer: With a tent peg through the temple
questions.explanation: Judges 4:21 (ESV): "...drove the peg into his temple until it went down into the ground..."

questions.question: Where did Deborah used to sit to judge?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:5 (ESV): "She used to sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel..."

questions.question: How many chariots of iron did Jabin have?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:3 (ESV): "...for he had 900 chariots of iron and he oppressed the people of Israel cruelly..."

questions.question: From which tribes did Barak summon men?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:10 (ESV): "And Barak called out Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh..."

questions.question: Where did Heber the Kenite separate from?
options: The Kenites, the descendants of Hobab
questions.correctAnswer: The Kenites, the descendants of Hobab
questions.explanation: Judges 4:11 (ESV): "Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses..."

questions.question: What did Jael give Sisera to drink?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:19 (ESV): "...So she opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink..."

questions.question: How long had Jabin oppressed Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:3 (ESV): "...he oppressed the people of Israel cruelly for twenty years."

questions.question: Where was Sisera's headquarters?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:2 (ESV): "...The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim."

questions.question: What did Jael cover Sisera with?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:18 (ESV): "...And when he had turned in to her into the tent, she covered him with a rug."

questions.question: What did Barak find when he arrived at Jael's tent?
options: Sisera lying dead with the peg in his temple
questions.correctAnswer: Sisera lying dead with the peg in his temple
questions.explanation: Judges 4:22 (ESV): "...And there lay Sisera dead, with the tent peg in his temple."

questions.question: Who was Jabin the king of?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:2 (ESV): "...Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor."

key_verse_text: ...for the LORD will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. (ESV)
